subject: Mathematics

source.topic: This is where people live: Numeracy
source.subtopic: Counts buildings, windows, doors and tiles on Poster 17

show.line: Look at the houses in the street. Count the windows and doors with me!

rounds.prompt: Count the windows on this house. How many?
Count the doors in the street.
Count the roof tiles. Say the number.
How many huts in the village?
Count the windows on the block of flats.

hints: Touch each window as you count.
Count the top row, then the bottom row.

beat_the_tutor.setup: My turn! I will count the windows.
beat_the_tutor.tutor_try: One, two, three, four, five windows!
beat_the_tutor.win_line: You caught me! There are only four windows.
beat_the_tutor.gentle_line: Let's count together. One, two, three, four windows!

parent_line: Can count the windows, doors and houses in a picture.
